review_method: Independent source and property review separate from model construction and production implementation.
Inspect real journal/transaction and authority boundaries, challenge mutation mechanisms and reachability, and add adversarial implementation tests.
Read final formal summary and command/trail inventory; verify exact model/runner hashes and retained archive digest.
accepted_claims: The named safety and finite-settlement properties hold for the declared finite Promela models under their recorded assumptions.
Governed completion receipt and execution-step completion share one SQLite transaction; protocol completion is separately repaired from retained safe state.
Current-authority checks occur at the represented admission/delivery boundaries, including after inspection; file checks are not linearised with subsequent effects.
Bounded component inspection validates exact source, detector/configuration identity, coverage and retained projection; its receipt is included in policy byte admission.
Known host completion and external certainty survive withheld payloads, while unresolved effects remain non-executable on retry.
The N3 slice retains safe intent before separately admitting notification, binds event and target, and distinguishes endpoint acceptance, refusal, not-sent and uncertainty from recipient delivery.

correspondence_limits: This is finite model checking plus source correspondence and implementation tests; no formal Rust/Python refinement theorem is claimed.
Projection, exact JSON/HMAC comparisons, detector/configuration equality and external certainty are abstract classes; code tests establish narrower concrete conformance.
A current check comprises separate authentication/key/authority file reads. The model permits authority changes between checks and later commits or dispatch.
Progress assumes bounded returning work or enforced external deadlines and surviving storage; no fairness, wall-clock SLO or eventual reconciliation theorem is supplied.
The N3 model composes adapter ordering with the host model by correspondence, not a formal cross-model refinement proof.
The trusted-local native callback can access unmediated resources. These results establish neither malicious-worker confinement nor production data-loss prevention.

N2: General unstructured release and domain/language detector qualification.
Cross-field and conversational context, numeric identifiers, extraction/attachment coverage.
Complete acquisition/inference/revision/diagnostic mediation, general evidence lineage/resolver/shared subscribers and current credential lifecycle.
N3: Automatic handling-event integration beyond the explicit trusted response workflow.
Authorised case retrieval/adjudication, escalation and durable bounded notification scheduling.
Provider-specific reconciliation of unknown submissions, shared flood prioritisation and live endpoint-contract qualification.
dependent_release_gates: E4 payload deletion/expiry/restore and E5 worker isolation.
Consumer/CSO integration and measured deployment/capacity qualification.
Managed/shared profiles remain outside the accepted trusted-local scope.
